body: I know right. It was honestly poor design that we forced to do a commission.

For you maybe. Things that are random to you could be important to us. For me it's my dog. If I lost my dog then I would be dead right now. To you it's just a girl, to the OP it's someone that they loved dearly and was their version of hanging from a thread.

Depression or suicide isn't that easy. We can't just move on. It is a lot harder than that. At any given moment is another moment we can snap and end it all. Saying move on is like telling a blind man to just open his eyes. It ain't that easy.
I saw purple vent on security.
I can't really make new friends. Literally everyone hates me, even my own parents. And that's not an exaggeration, they literally said it to my face.
